<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}/credential-rotations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Replaces the password of credentials.

Send an empty body to generate a password that meets your organization's password policy, or send
`Password` to set your own. The old password stops working immediately; open sessions aren't
interrupted.

The response doesn't include the new password. Retrieve the credentials to read it.
